candidate_policy: all causal non-debris STARLINK candidates from prepare_adaptive_tle_position_inputs, retained only if a conservative regional normal-cap bound permits above-horizon visibility at queried epochs

geometry.mapping: provisional; both RX-to-slot symmetries evaluated and training-selected
geometry.orientation: learned ENU fixture yaw, shared tilt <=45 degrees; 15-degree yaw/azimuth and 5-degree tilt grid

identity_scope: full receipt-bound causal non-debris Starlink cache; point-local reassociation
orientation_constraint: fixture tilt fixed at zero; yaw fitted
position_scope: blind within predeclared Sacramento-250km prior; no saved-site candidate identity
randomized_partition: receipt-bound per-track mask profiles CFO and association on training samples; held samples report diagnostics only

regional_filter.criterion: retain if max p.dot(n) over either regional normal cap reaches the semi-minor axis at one queried epoch; uncertain candidates remain

session_policy: all five explicitly capture-bound LT3D-001A sessions
